summary.text: Donnie Loftis is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 109, which he has represented since November 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Donnie Loftis served as chair of the CaroMont Health board and as a Gaston County commissioner.
He also served in the U.S. Army during the war in Iraq.
He succeeded Dana Bumgardner in the state House.
